_note: The "What's new" spotlights (issues #196, #197 and #198). One item for each change of the sprint that a learner or a visitor can see. id: the id that the spotlight on the page uses, and that profiles.seen_news keeps (only a-z, 0-9 and -). audience: visitor (the pages before log-in; the browser keeps the seen items) or learner (the pages after log-in; the account keeps them). released and until: the spotlight shows from released to until, both days included. pr: the pull request of the change. Write the text in ASD-STE100.

items.title: Try the 3D breadboard here
items.text: The 3D breadboard is now at the top of the home page. Tap the two glowing holes to make your first wire. You do not need an account.

items.title: Scroll to build Perch
items.text: Scroll down the page. Each scroll puts the parts of the next level on the board. With the last part, the screen of Perch shows its face.

items.title: Meet the mascots
items.text: Each project has a mascot that helps you. Now you can see all four mascots here, next to the projects.

items.title: Practice on your own board
items.text: The practice wire now uses the board of the project that you start with: the Arduino Uno or the ESP32-S3.

items.title: Read the datasheet
items.text: Pick a module in the parts tray, then open its datasheet card. It shows what the part does, its power, its pinout and a link to the real datasheet.

items.title: Share links need a log-in
items.text: Your friend or your TA must log in to Jumper to open your share link. After the log-in, they see your build.
